Ben / Priyom — quick updates below; I pulled the artifacts and wrote short answers you can hand to Gridspan. I also uploaded the full redacted SOC2 and the pen-test attestation to the shared Drive link.

1) SOC 2: We can share a redacted SOC 2 Type II report (covers security & availability). Report period: 2027-10-01 to 2028-03-31. Redaction allowed for vendor/client IDs; internal control descriptions remain. Artifact: redwood-soc2-typeII-redacted.pdf (on drive).

2) Pen test: Third-party pen test completed 2028-05-12. We provide an attestation summary (pen-test-attestation-stub.pdf). Full report requires NDA; we can get a redacted executive summary.

3) Data retention & deletion API: We have a deletion API (POST /v1/tenants/{id}/data/delete) that returns a job id and final state. Retention windows are configurable per deployment; default hosted retention is 90 days for logs, embeddings and 30 days for transient token cache unless customer opts in to longer. Proof of deletion: we return deletion-job status plus a cryptographic deletion confirmation (sha256) in the response. See attachment data-retention-answers.txt for sample request/response.

4) SLA: Priyom — we should confirm the numbers below before sending externally. Quick draft: Hosted: P95 latency SLA not guaranteed; offered SLO guidance (best-effort) + standard uptime 99.95% for hosted API (no financial credits). Dedicated: SLA options available for reserved pools — baseline 99.9% with credits; premium tiers 99.95% with a credit schedule. We can share the MSA/SLA draft for procurement review.

Drive artifacts (public to Gridspan with restricted view): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bGridspanEvidence

I can join a security call Wed 9/6 at 10am PT if Gridspan wants a synchronous review.

-Neha
